name: OSuite
description: OSuite helps teams review important work before Claude takes it. It checks planned high-risk actions, routes sensitive steps into approval when needed, records the final outcome, and keeps replay and verification links in one audit-ready record. Use it for publishing, deployments, production changes, and other decisions that need clear oversight without exposing internal governance complexity to end users.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OSuite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OSuite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://studio.osuite.ai/api/connectors/osuite/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OSuite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OSuite provides these MCP tools: review_planned_work, check_if_approved, record_final_outcome, and open_audit_record.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OSuite?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OSuite in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
OSuite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OSuite is developed by Ond Holdings Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
